name: B10-0286/2025 (PfE) – Case of Ahmadreza Djalali in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Dr Ahmadreza Djalali in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for Iran to free Ahmadreza Djalali, a Swedish-Iranian researcher arrested in Tehran in 2016 and sentenced to death after what the text calls a mock trial. It says he was tortured into false confessions and had a heart attack in May 2025. The Parliament condemns Iran's practice of holding foreign and dual nationals as bargaining chips, and asks the Council to add everyone responsible for human rights abuses in Iran to the European Union's sanctions list.

- Nothing changes yet; the Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It concerns Djalali, other detained European and dual nationals, and Iranian officials who could be sanctioned.
- Next, the Parliament sends the text to the relevant parties; the Council decides on sanctions.
